cases.sentence: На двенадцатом ___ правления Ахаза Осия стал царем Израиля в Самарии.
cases.translation: In the twelfth year of Ahaz's reign, Hoshea became king of Israel in Samaria.
cases.explain: The preposition на with the prepositional case indicates the time period.

cases.sentence: Они поклонялись другим богам и следовали обычаям ___ , которых Господь прогнал от них.
cases.translation: They worshipped other gods and followed the customs of the peoples the Lord drove out.
cases.explain: The genitive plural shows possession - customs belonging to those peoples.

cases.sentence: Салмонасар, ___ Осирии, пошел войной на Осию.
cases.translation: Shalmaneser, king of Assyria, went to war against Hoshea.
cases.explain: The subject of the sentence uses the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Царь обнаружил, что Осия послал вестников к Со, ___ Египта.
cases.translation: The king discovered that Hoshea had sent messengers to So, king of Egypt.
cases.explain: The dative case shows to whom the messengers were sent.

cases.sentence: Израилетяне согрешили против Господа, своего ___ , который вывел их из Египта.
cases.translation: The Israelites sinned against the Lord their God, who brought them out of Egypt.
cases.explain: The possessive genitive shows that the God belonged to Israel.

cases.sentence: Израилетяне строили святилища на возвышенностях во всех городах, от сторожевой башни до укрепленного ___.
cases.translation: The Israelites built high places in all their cities, from the watchtower to the fortified city.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows the extent or limit - up to the fortified city.

cases.sentence: Господь предостерегал Израиль и Иудею через пророков и ___.
cases.translation: The Lord warned Israel and Judah through prophets and seers.
cases.explain: The accusative case shows the direct object - the seers through whom warnings came.

cases.sentence: Они поклонялись Баалу и приносили сыновей и дочерей в огненную ___.
cases.translation: They worshipped Baal and offered their sons and daughters as burnt sacrifices.
cases.explain: The accusative case shows the direct object - the sacrifices being offered.

reading.ru: На двенадцатом году правления Ахаза, царя Иудеи, Осия, сын Эллы, стал царем Израиля в Самарии и правил девять лет.
reading.question: How long did Hoshea reign in Israel?
reading.explain: The text explicitly states that Hoshea reigned in Samaria for nine years.

reading.ru: Он делал зло в глазах Господа, но не так, как цари Израиля, которые были до него.
reading.question: How was Hoshea's evil different from his predecessors?
options: His evil was less severe than previous kings
His evil was worse than previous kings
He did not sin at all
reading.correct: His evil was less severe than previous kings
reading.explain: The text says Hoshea did evil but not like the kings of Israel before him.

reading.ru: Они поклонялись другим богам и следовали обычаям народов, которых Господь прогнал от них.
reading.question: What was the major sin of the Israelites?
options: Worshipping other gods and following pagan customs
reading.correct: Worshipping other gods and following pagan customs
reading.explain: The text lists worshipping other gods and following the customs of pagan nations as the primary sin.

reading.ru: На девятом году правления Осии царь Осирийский взял Самарию и увел израилетян в плен в Осирию.
reading.question: What happened to Samaria in the ninth year of Hoshea?
options: It was captured and Israelites were taken into captivity
reading.correct: It was captured and Israelites were taken into captivity
reading.explain: The text says the king of Assyria took Samaria and carried Israel away to Assyria as captives.

reading.ru: Это произошло потому, что израилетяне согрешили против Господа, своего Бога, который вывел их из Египта.
reading.question: Why did the Lord allow Israel to be taken into captivity?
options: Because they had sinned against the Lord their God
Because Egypt declared war on them
Because they made a bad treaty
reading.correct: Because they had sinned against the Lord their God
reading.explain: The text explains that Israel's captivity was a consequence of sinning against the Lord their God.

reading.ru: Они отвергли все повеления Господа своего Бога и сделали себе двух идолов, отлитых в виде тельцов.
reading.question: What idols did the Israelites make?
reading.explain: The text specifically states they made two idols in the form of calves.
